description: This file contains helper functions and default state data for managing local storage of mock user data, including profile, skills, mock tests, applications, settings, and notifications for the Talenvia application.

methods.name: safeParse
methods.description: Parses JSON string safely, returning fallback on error.

methods.name: getDefaultState
methods.description: Returns the default mock data state for Talenvia.

methods.name: loadAppState
methods.description: Loads application state from local storage, falling back to default state if necessary.

methods.name: saveAppState
methods.description: Saves the current application state to local storage.
